purpose: Turn each portfolio project into a durable local planning/integration brain so generic /wc capacity disperses across projects and produces visible product work without a privileged global Guide.
laws: Each project brain has a stable STATE.json with monotonic revision.
A project-guide candidate fingerprints project_id + exact STATE revision + grounded project evidence, so finishing a cycle and incrementing revision opens a new cycle without duplicating the old one.
Project guides may run in parallel even though they share GUIDE_PLANNER role.

A project guide must consume local returns, maintain 2-5 grounded executable jobs, update its STATE by CAS, and execute or verify at least one local job when possible; planning-only closure is not success.

An intentional SOURCE_DEBT boundary with empty frontier_refs plus explicit NEW_EVIDENCE_GATE suppresses PROJECT_FRONTIER_THIN until project STATE changes on genuinely new evidence; do not spin revisions merely to satisfy frontier_min_per_project.
Generic /wc batches shard across role_ready candidates; no human project routing is required.
Infrastructure/control-plane work is secondary while product projects have frontier gaps unless a measured critical regression blocks execution.
Visible product changes should update associated page/news state when a registered surface exists.
No project guide may promote Current/Human Accepted/Served without authority.
A productive /wc should chain multiple durable units in the same chat instead of closing after the first RETURN.
BOUNDARY/NO_ACTION/telemetry-only outcomes do not count as productive units.
Three productive units is a checkpoint, not a stop condition, for explicit batches.
Explicit-batch workers target 6 productive units and may continue to 8 while compatible product or assist work remains.
Long but safely decomposable owned work may publish at most two bounded assist child jobs; helpers never share the parent's exclusive integration target.
done_contract: frontier contains at least frontier_min_per_project grounded jobs or exact evidence explains why not
at least one local executable/verification job attempted when available
receipt references state revision before/after and changed/created work
worker_chain_stop_conditions: no compatible claimable product/assist/guide work after bounded allocator attempts

source_debt_planner_gate.clear_rule: A materially new source/evidence event must update project STATE so the gate predicate no longer holds before planning resumes.

close_when: no compatible product/assist/guide work remains after bounded allocation

assist_protocol.trigger: After the first heartbeat, if substantive work remains and the job can be decomposed into non-overlapping safe scopes.
child_job_requirements: assist_scope describing a non-overlapping bounded subproblem
no mutation of the parent's exclusive integration target unless the child owns a separate isolated candidate path
helper returns evidence/candidate only; parent owner or later steward retains integration authority
assist_protocol.helper_priority: After checkpoint, prefer claimable assist children before generic infrastructure work.
forbidden: ad-hoc inspection of another active worker without a published assist job
two helpers mutating the same exclusive target
splitting tasks whose safety depends on single-owner atomicity
